name: Wizlo Bearingshiner
summary: Wizlo Bearingshiner is a goblin tinkerer stranded at Whitereach Post in Thousand Needles. The sole survivor of a centaur attack on his caravan, he recruits travelers to recover a valuable Hypercapacitor Gizmo from the wreckage.

sections.title: An Engineer at the Post
sections.body: Staying alongside the tauren at Whitereach Post along the canyon road, Wizlo Bearingshiner faces an unwelcome delay. Centaur attacked his caravan, leaving him as its only survivor. His clients are waiting for their wares, and he worries that he will not deliver them in time.

sections.title: A Stranded Shipment
sections.body: Wizlo's best gizmo hangs around the neck of a fierce panther caged beside his ruined caravan north of Whitereach Post. Even the centaur avoid the beast. Wizlo offers travelers the cage key and a reward for recovering the hypercapacitor, though he admits he has yet to work out what the device actually does.

faq.answer: Wizlo Bearingshiner is a goblin tinkerer stranded at Whitereach Post in Thousand Needles after centaur attacked his caravan. He seeks help recovering a Hypercapacitor Gizmo from a caged panther.

faq.q: Where can I find Wizlo Bearingshiner?
faq.answer: He is located at Whitereach Post, a Horde camp along the road near Camp E'thok in Thousand Needles.

faq.q: What kind of experiments does he run?
faq.answer: Wizlo is trying to recover his Hypercapacitor Gizmo. He admits that he still needs to figure out what it does; the device's exact function is unknown.

faq.q: Why is a goblin working with the Horde at Whitereach Post?
faq.answer: Whitereach Post is an unintended stop for Wizlo. Centaur attacked his caravan nearby, and he is stranded while his clients await their shipments.

faq.q: Does Wizlo belong to the Steamwheedle Cartel?
faq.answer: No Steamwheedle affiliation is established for Wizlo. He is stationed with the Horde at Whitereach Post and is concerned with recovering his goods and delivering them to his clients.
The Hypercapacitor Gizmo is a valuable device carried by a caged panther beside Wizlo's wrecked caravan. Its exact purpose is unknown—even Wizlo says he has yet to figure out what it does.

angles.text: Engineers may sympathize with Wizlo's desire to recover the mysterious Hypercapacitor Gizmo and discover what it does.
While making camp at Whitereach Post alongside the local Tauren, Horde travelers can easily employ Wizlo's mechanical expertise to secure useful gadgets.
